📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-28-tables-fields-editview-viewgen-failed-after-retry` + `ki-2026-07-06-tables-fields-alter-column-ddl-syntax-error`
Two distinct known bugs fired concurrently under this monitor (occurrence #2 for each). A 3rd, undocumented signature was also observed (1 trace) — not KB'd yet, see note below.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)

**Bug 1 — EditView ViewGen failed after retry (occ #2):** ViewService.EditView (ViewService.cs:394) retries view regeneration once then throws "Failed to generate view {X} after retry" when the legacy SyncServicesHelper.fnCreateViewFromTableName keeps failing. 7 distinct traces this fire (up from 1 documented baseline).
Playbook: confirm ES buckets Table View Creation Failed + EditView ViewGen failed after retry + SaveFieldLegacyExtended Failed co-occur on the same trace_id; root cause inside legacy SyncServicesHelper still needs-human.

**Bug 2 — AlterTableToDropColumn SQL syntax error (occ #2):** TableProvider.AlterTableToDropColumn (TableProvider.cs:405) builds an unbracketed "ALTER TABLE {tableName} DROP COLUMN {columnName}" via raw string interpolation, producing a SqlException "Incorrect syntax near COLUMN". 2 distinct traces this fire.
Playbook: confirm ES buckets AlterTableToDropColumn Failed / Incorrect syntax near COLUMN / Mode:Delete Failed; fix is bracket-quoting tableName/columnName like the sibling index-rebuild SQL already does.

**New, unconfirmed (not yet KB'd):** 1 trace — System.NullReferenceException in FieldService.GetDropDownField (FieldService.cs:538), distinct from ki-2026-07-11's HelperConverter.GetFields NRE. Holding per the 2nd-occurrence-creates-the-entry precedent on this monitor.

Open Jira: n/a — neither fix_jira set
